project_type: TanStack Start SSR app (React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4), TypeScript strict mode
build_system: Vite 8.1.5 via @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config. TanStack Router plugin auto-generates routeTree.gen.ts on build — never edit that file manually. Path alias @/* maps to ./src/*.
test_framework: Vitest 4 with jsdom environment, globals:true, setupFiles: src/test/setup.ts. Pattern: src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}
test_command: npm run test  OR  npx vitest run  (in c:\Users\bipul\OneDrive\Desktop\leapy\frontend)
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build — must exit 0 with no TS errors. 2) npm run test — all tests must pass. 3) Confirm routeTree.gen.ts contains '/chat' after build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by TanStack Router plugin on every build. Never edit it; it regenerates automatically when src/routes/chat.tsx is created.
environment_constraints: VITE_LIPIAI_CHAT_URL and VITE_LIPIAI_ANALYSIS_URL must be accessed via import.meta.env['VITE_LIPIAI_CHAT_URL'] (bracket notation, not dot) to satisfy noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature. Do not add a .env file — only .env.example.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Key rules from tsconfig.json: strict=true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true, noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature=true, noImplicitReturns=true. Array[0] returns T|undefined — use ! assertion for guaranteed non-null const arrays.
key_patterns: Routes: createFileRoute('/path')({ head: () => ({meta:[...]}), component: ComponentFn }) — see src/routes/about.tsx and src/routes/dashboard.tsx. Services: plain async fetch functions returning typed promises, check endpoint env var first, cast response.json() to Record<string,unknown> then narrow — see src/lib/inscription-analysis.ts. Components: import from @/components/ui/*, use cn() from @/lib/utils for className merging, BEM-inspired CSS class names (block__element--modifier). CSS: append to src/styles.css, use oklch() for all color values matching existing vars, define custom vars in the second :root block.
relevant_files: src/routes/__root.tsx (head/fonts — needs Noto Sans Newa added)
directory_structure: frontend/src/routes/ — file-based pages. frontend/src/components/ — React components. frontend/src/components/ui/ — shadcn/ui primitives. frontend/src/lib/ — service/utility modules. frontend/src/test/ — vitest tests. frontend/src/styles.css — single CSS file. frontend/.agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts (not part of the app).
